review_type: AI-assisted second review, not additional human ratings or Claude audit
scope: 18 selected legacy adapter claims; full historical inputs reviewed; no external articles or test data

rubric.supported: Core factual claims directly supported; reasonable qualified inference distinguished from observation.
rubric.partly_supported: Some factual content supported, but attribution, benchmark or stronger interpretation lacks evidence. Does not label entire claim false.
rubric.uncertain: Key factual attribution or degree cannot be resolved from available input.
rubric.confidence: Confidence in evidence sufficiency, not forecast confidence or probability of factual truth.
